answer: Sequential challenge inheritance: each identity must solve a fresh, unpublished puzzle derived from the prior block's unrepeatable answer, then sign it. A valid solution seeds the next puzzle, so copies land on already-consumed riddles and fail. Attackers must solve every fork's chain live, paying compute at the network's peak. A wrong wander off-chain voids the stake-free slot, forcing full recomputation. Disturbance from a clone makes a detectable ripple across siblings. The zenith of forgery cost equals sustained parallel solving, not one-time registration.
